name: Rope (50 feet)
desc: 50 feet of hempen rope. As a Utilize action, you can tie a knot (DC 10 Dexterity (Sleight of Hand) check). Bursting it requires a DC 20 Strength (Athletics) check. You can bind only a creature that is Grappled, Incapacitated, or Restrained; escaping requires a DC 15 Dexterity (Acrobatics) check.
